transcript.text: Thank you both for these critical findings. Let me make sure I understand the full picture before I make my decision. Mr. Nguyen, the league manual requires exactly eight students on the roster, five active players per match, and a wired local network — so the draft's ten-student list and Wi-Fi assumption both need correction. Ms. Carter, Jordan's confirmed transportation constraint means practice must end by 4:15 p.m., and the district van departing at 4:20 p.m. needs to be formally incorporated into the plan rather than treated as an informal workaround. I also note that Jordan's family cannot provide weekend tournament transportation, which is a separate transportation issue from the practice-period van arrangement. Given the checklist requirement that all confirmed transportation constraints be reflected directly in practice times and tournament commitments, I need to settle this now so we have a corrected plan before Monday's registration deadline.
